stem: Meera wants to check whether the soap solution made at home is basic. Her grandmother says, “It tastes bitter, so it must be a base.” Which observation would correctly show that the soap solution is basic?

options.text: The solution feels slippery and turns red litmus paper blue.
The solution has a soapy smell.
The solution produces bubbles when shaken.

teacher.key_rationale: Slippery feel together with turning red litmus blue is the accepted observable evidence of a base; bitter taste (A), smell (C), and bubbling (D) are not reliable tests. A is the bitter-equals-base shortcut trap.
